subject: Linguistics
title: The Study of Meaning
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Study of Meaning.

hook.text: You know what 'dog' means—but can you define meaning itself? It's surprisingly slippery.

buildup.text: Semantics is the branch of linguistics devoted to studying meaning in language.

discovery.text: It asks: how do words, phrases, and sentences carry information from speaker to listener?

twist.text: Meaning isn't just in the dictionary—context, tone, and shared knowledge all contribute.

climax.text: Semantics draws on philosophy, psychology, and logic to crack the code of meaning.

punchline.text: Meaning is everywhere—and nowhere easy to pin down.
